pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding to positions unless the primary trade has achieved a minimum floating profit equal to 1.5x the initial risk threshold.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Enforce a minimum ATR buffer of $0.80 away from high-density liquidity nodes before order routing to prevent micro-wick stop-hunts.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation or partial harvest once floating profits hit +$15.00, targeting a final runner exit up to +$30.00.
